thesis: FORMAT DEMONSTRATION ONLY. A growth company with rising guidance and a favourable market trend; no real security is recommended.

price_performance.summary: Illustration: report 1-day, 5-day, 1-month and 3-month returns, volatility, liquidity and distance from recent highs.

catalysts_risks.summary: Illustration: explain next earnings date, thesis failure conditions, dilution, competition and downside scenario. Do not present targets as guaranteed.
